title: THE THEATER OF SHADOWS
description: A diva's final act ends in silence — literally. The whole cast has an alibi, but only one of them is lying.
incidentReport: Mireille, star of the Blackbriar Theater, was found dead center-stage after the curtain fell. The murder weapon was left at the scene. Countess Nocturne, Hazel, Ozwin, and Whiskers were the only ones still in the building.

interviews.speaker: Hazel
interviews.statement: I never left my cauldron in the Library, ask the fumes.

interviews.speaker: Ozwin
interviews.statement: I was chained to my ledger in the Office, cursing unpaid invoices.

interviews.speaker: Whiskers
interviews.statement: I slept through the whole night in the Bedroom, purr's honor.

interviews.speaker: Countess Nocturne
interviews.statement: I never set foot on that stage.

clues: The Bowie Knife lay sheathed and pristine in the Office drawer, never drawn.
The Poison bottle sat corked and full on the Library's top shelf, seal intact.
The Trophy gleamed, dust-free but untouched, in the Bedroom display case.
The Slipknot's frayed end dangled from the Theater's rigging above center stage.
Hazel was brewing potions in the Library, cauldron bubbling till dawn.
Ozwin was locked in the Office, arguing with his ledger over unpaid spell fees.
Whiskers was curled up asleep in the Bedroom, snoring loud enough for witnesses to confirm.
